children: Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto appointed Suahasil Nazara as finance minister at a televised swearing-in ceremony Monday, replacing Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa.
Nazara had served as deputy finance minister since 2019. Purbaya was appointed finance minister in September 2025, succeeding Sri Mulyani Indrawati.

Nazara will serve as the finance minister for the remainder of the 2024-2029 term. His appointment follows a period of mixed signals on fiscal policy under Purbaya, Gareth Leather, senior Asia economist at Capital Economics, said in a note.

Purbaya's policies had also raised concerns about the independence of Bank Indonesia, Leather said, adding that Nazara will need to set out clearer priorities and provide more consistent policy signals.
The leadership change comes as Indonesia contends with a weakening currency and higher oil prices stemming from the continuing conflict in the Middle East.

Indonesia's stock market is also facing scrutiny from MSCI over shareholder and market transparency concerns. Itsaid in June that, if sufficient progress isn't evident by its November 2026 index review, it could consider reclassifying Indonesia from emerging-market to frontier-market status.
